edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against dogCore.ceoAddress() inside the onlyCEO modifier.
msg.sender is compared against dogCore.cfoAddress() inside the onlyCFO modifier.
rewardLottery requires msg.sender to equal finalLottery.
toSPool requires msg.sender to equal finalLottery.
registerLottery requires the caller to be the dogCore contract address.

random2's block.timestamp entropy feeds the weak randomness unsafe operation.
